title: Maryknoll House, Stanley

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the three mapped historic volumes and narrow connections, leaving the north courtyard and nearby Stanley Knoll housing outside.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the courtyard approach to the main north porch.

mapIdentity.provider: Exact mapped hilltop block and wings within the address-matched parcel, corroborated by the Town Planning Board conservation submission.
mapIdentity.scope: Three standing mapped roof and wall envelopes within the named Maryknoll parcel at 44 Stanley Village Road control the main block and two wings. The open north court and neighboring properties are distinct.

note: The 2025 submission and public-domain courtyard view confirm the three-storey main block, two lower wings, green glazed pan-and-roll tile roofs, brick façades, paired timber windows, granite bases and the central north threshold. The existing and proposed development are distinguished.
